title: The Complete Works of William Shakespeare (MIT)
institution: Jeremy Hylton; operated by The Tech (MIT), hosted by MIT IS&T
author: William Shakespeare
notes: Online since 1993. HTML pages for the 37 plays, the Sonnets, Venus and Adonis, The Rape of Lucrece, A Lover's Complaint and A Funeral Elegy. All of it dates from 1450-1700. The text comes from the Moby Shakespeare, a modernised-spelling text, not a transcription of the early prints. HTML public domain according to the site. Status: the home page says 'Current copy taken from GitHub and hosted by MIT IS&T in a static location' (5/10/23) and the repository's last push is 2023-09-19; nothing newer was found. The counts cover the GitHub repository's plays, sonnets and poems, including The Passionate Pilgrim and The Phoenix and the Turtle from its plain-text poetry file. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
